verses.original: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος Θεοῦ καὶ Τιμόθεος ὁ ἀδελφὸς
verses.transliteration: Paulos apostolos Christou Iēsou dia thelēmatos Theou kai Timotheos ho adelphos
verses.literal: Paul an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God and Timothy our brother
verses.literalPt: Paulo, apóstolo de Cristo Jesus por vontade de Deus, e Timóteo, nosso irmão,

verses.original: Τοῖς ἐν Κολοσσαῖς ἁγίοις καὶ πιστοῖς ἀδελφοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ Χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Tois en Kolossais hagiois kai pistois adelphois en Christō Charis hymin kai eirēnē apo Theou Patros hēmōn
verses.literal: To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae Grace and peace to you from God our Father
verses.literalPt: aos santos e fiéis irmãos em Cristo que estão em Colossos: graça a vós e paz da parte de Deus, nosso Pai.

verses.original: Εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ Θεῷ Πατρὶ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν προσευχόμενοι
verses.transliteration: Eucharistoumen tō Theō Patri tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou pantote peri hymōn proseuchomenoi
verses.literal: We always thank . . . God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ when we pray for you
verses.literalPt: Damos graças a Deus, Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, sempre orando por vós,

verses.original: ἀκούσαντες τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην ἣν ἔχετε εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους
verses.transliteration: akousantes tēn pistin hymōn en Christō Iēsou kai tēn agapēn hēn echete eis pantas tous hagious
verses.literal: because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all the saints
verses.literalPt: desde que ouvimos a vossa fé em Cristo Jesus e o amor que tendes a todos os santos;

verses.original: διὰ τὴν ἐλπίδα τὴν ἀποκειμένην ὑμῖν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς ἣν προηκούσατε ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τῆς ἀληθείας τοῦ εὐαγγελίου
verses.transliteration: dia tēn elpida tēn apokeimenēn hymin en tois ouranois hēn proēkousate en tō logō tēs alētheias tou euangeliou
verses.literal: the faith and love proceeding from the hope stored up for you in heaven of which you have already heard in the word of truth the gospel
verses.literalPt: por causa da esperança que vos está guardada nos céus, a qual antes ouvistes pela palavra da verdade do evangelho

verses.original: τοῦ παρόντος εἰς ὑμᾶς καθὼς καὶ ἐν παντὶ τῷ κόσμῳ ἐστὶν καρποφορούμενον καὶ αὐξανόμενον καθὼς καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ἀφ’ ἧς ἡμέρας ἠκούσατε καὶ ἐπέγνωτε τὴν χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: tou parontos eis hymas kathōs kai en panti tō kosmō estin karpophoroumenon kai auxanomenon kathōs kai en hymin aph’ hēs hēmeras ēkousate kai epegnōte tēn charin tou Theou en alētheia
verses.literal: that has come to you - All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood the grace of God
verses.literalPt: que tem chegado a vós, como também está em todo o mundo, dando fruto e aumentando, assim como entre vós, desde o dia em que ouvistes e conhecestes a graça de Deus em verdade;

verses.original: καθὼς ἐμάθετε ἀπὸ Ἐπαφρᾶ τοῦ ἀγαπητοῦ συνδούλου ἡμῶν ὅς ἐστιν πιστὸς ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν διάκονος τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: kathōs emathete apo Epaphra tou agapētou syndoulou hēmōn hos estin pistos hyper hēmōn diakonos tou Christou
verses.literal: You learned it from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf
verses.literalPt: segundo aprendestes de Epafras, nosso amado conservo, que é por vós fiel ministro de Cristo,

verses.original: ὁ καὶ δηλώσας ἡμῖν τὴν ὑμῶν ἀγάπην ἐν Πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: ho kai dēlōsas hēmin tēn hymōn agapēn en Pneumati
verses.literal: and who also informed us of your love in the Spirit
verses.literalPt: o qual também nos declarou o vosso amor no Espírito.

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ἡμεῖς ἀφ’ ἧς ἡμέρας ἠκούσαμεν οὐ παυόμεθα ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν προσευχόμενοι καὶ αἰτούμενοι ἵνα πληρωθῆτε τὴν ἐπίγνωσιν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ καὶ συνέσει πνευματικῇ
verses.transliteration: Dia touto kai hēmeis aph’ hēs hēmeras ēkousamen ou pauometha hyper hymōn proseuchomenoi kai aitoumenoi hina plērōthēte tēn epignōsin tou thelēmatos autou en pasē sophia kai synesei pneumatikē
verses.literal: For this reason . . . . . . since the day we heard about you we have not stopped praying for you and asking God to fill you with the knowledge of His will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding
verses.literalPt: Por isso, nós também, desde o dia em que o ouvimos, não cessamos de orar por vós e de pedir que sejais cheios do pleno conhecimento da sua vontade, em toda a sabedoria e entendimento espiritual;

verses.original: περιπατῆσαι ἀξίως τοῦ Κυρίου εἰς πᾶσαν ἀρεσκείαν ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ καρποφοροῦντες καὶ αὐξανόμενοι τῇ ἐπιγνώσει τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: peripatēsai axiōs tou Kyriou eis pasan areskeian en panti ergō agathō karpophorountes kai auxanomenoi tē epignōsei tou Theou
verses.literal: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord and may please Him in every way bearing fruit in every good work growing in the knowledge of God
verses.literalPt: de sorte que andeis de uma maneira digna do Senhor, agradando-lhe em tudo, frutificando em toda boa obra e crescendo no pleno conhecimento de Deus;

verses.original: ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει δυναμούμενοι κατὰ τὸ κράτος τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ εἰς πᾶσαν ὑπομονὴν καὶ μακροθυμίαν μετὰ χαρᾶς
verses.transliteration: en pasē dynamei dynamoumenoi kata to kratos tēs doxēs autou eis pasan hypomonēn kai makrothymian meta charas
verses.literal: being strengthened with all power according to His glorious might so that you may have full endurance and patience and joyfully . . .
verses.literalPt: sendo fortalecidos com toda a força, segundo o poder da sua glória, em toda a fortaleza e longanimidade,

verses.original: εὐχαριστοῦντες τῷ Πατρὶ τῷ ἱκανώσαντι ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν μερίδα τοῦ κλήρου τῶν ἁγίων ἐν τῷ φωτί
verses.transliteration: eucharistountes tō Patri tō hikanōsanti hymas eis tēn merida tou klērou tōn hagiōn en tō phōti
verses.literal: giving thanks to the Father who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints in the light
verses.literalPt: dando, com alegria, graças ao Pai, que vos fez idôneos, para participardes da herança dos santos em luz.

verses.original: ὃς ἐρρύσατο ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῆς ἐξουσίας τοῦ σκότους καὶ μετέστησεν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Υἱοῦ τῆς ἀγάπης αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hos errysato hēmas ek tēs exousias tou skotous kai metestēsen eis tēn basileian tou Huiou tēs agapēs autou
verses.literal: He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son
verses.literalPt: Ele nos resgatou do poder das trevas e nos trasladou para o reino do seu Filho muito amado,

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν τὴν ἄφεσιν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: en hō echomen tēn apolytrōsin tēn aphesin tōn hamartiōn
verses.literal: in whom we have redemption the forgiveness of sins
verses.literalPt: no qual temos a nossa redenção, a remissão dos nossos pecados;

verses.original: Ὅς ἐστιν εἰκὼν τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ἀοράτου πρωτότοκος πάσης κτίσεως
verses.transliteration: Hos estin eikōn tou Theou tou aoratou prōtotokos pasēs ktiseōs
verses.literal: The Son is the image of the invisible God the firstborn over all creation
verses.literalPt: e que é a imagem do Deus invisível, o primogênito de toda a criação.

verses.original: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐκτίσθη τὰ πάντα ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τὰ ὁρατὰ καὶ τὰ ἀόρατα εἴτε θρόνοι εἴτε κυριότητες εἴτε ἀρχαὶ εἴτε ἐξουσίαι τὰ πάντα δι’ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν ἔκτισται
verses.transliteration: hoti en autō ektisthē ta panta en tois ouranois kai epi tēs gēs ta horata kai ta aorata eite thronoi eite kyriotētes eite archai eite exousiai ta panta di’ autou kai eis auton ektistai
verses.literal: For in Him all things were created things in heaven and on earth visible and invisible whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities All things were created through Him and for Him
verses.literalPt: Pois nele foram criadas todas as coisas nos céus e sobre a terra, as visíveis e as invisíveis, quer sejam tronos, quer dominações, quer principados, quer potestades; todas as coisas têm sido criadas por ele e para ele.

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτός ἐστιν πρὸ πάντων καὶ τὰ πάντα ἐν αὐτῷ συνέστηκεν
verses.transliteration: Kai autos estin pro pantōn kai ta panta en autō synestēken
verses.literal: He is before all things and in Him all things hold together
verses.literalPt: Ele é antes de todas as coisas, e nele subsistem todas as coisas;

verses.original: καὶ αὐτός ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλὴ τοῦ σώματος τῆς ἐκκλησίας ὅς ἐστιν ἡ ἀρχή πρωτότοκος ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν ἵνα γένηται ἐν πᾶσιν αὐτὸς πρωτεύων
verses.transliteration: kai autos estin hē kephalē tou sōmatos tēs ekklēsias hos estin hē archē prōtotokos ek tōn nekrōn hina genētai en pasin autos prōteuōn
verses.literal: And He is the head of the body the church He is the beginning and firstborn from among the dead so that in all things He may have preeminence
verses.literalPt: e ele é a cabeça do corpo, da Igreja. Ele é o princípio, o primogênito dentre os mortos, para que em todas as coisas tenha a primazia,

verses.original: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ εὐδόκησεν πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα κατοικῆσαι
verses.transliteration: hoti en autō eudokēsen pan to plērōma katoikēsai
verses.literal: For God was pleased to have all His fullness dwell in Him
verses.literalPt: porque aprouve a Deus que nele habitasse toda a plenitude

verses.original: καὶ δι’ αὐτοῦ ἀποκαταλλάξαι τὰ πάντα εἰς αὐτόν εἰρηνοποιήσας διὰ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ σταυροῦ αὐτοῦ δι’ αὐτοῦ εἴτε τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἴτε τὰ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai di’ autou apokatallaxai ta panta eis auton eirēnopoiēsas dia tou haimatos tou staurou autou di’ autou eite ta epi tēs gēs eite ta en tois ouranois
verses.literal: and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things whether things on earth or things in heaven by making peace through the blood of His cross
verses.literalPt: e, por ele, reconciliar todas as coisas a si mesmo, tendo feito paz pelo sangue da sua cruz, por ele, digo, quer as coisas sobre a terra, quer as nos céus.

verses.original: Καὶ ὑμᾶς ποτε ὄντας ἀπηλλοτριωμένους καὶ ἐχθροὺς τῇ διανοίᾳ ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τοῖς πονηροῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai hymas pote ontas apēllotriōmenous kai echthrous tē dianoia en tois ergois tois ponērois
verses.literal: Once you were alienated from God and were hostile in your minds engaging in - evil deeds
verses.literalPt: Vós, sendo, outrora, alienados e inimigos no vosso entendimento pelas vossas más obras,

verses.original: νυνὶ δὲ ἀποκατήλλαξεν ἐν τῷ σώματι τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ διὰ τοῦ θανάτου παραστῆσαι ὑμᾶς ἁγίους καὶ ἀμώμους καὶ ἀνεγκλήτους κατενώπιον αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: nyni de apokatēllaxen en tō sōmati tēs sarkos autou dia tou thanatou parastēsai hymas hagious kai amōmous kai anenklētous katenōpion autou
verses.literal: But now He has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy unblemished and blameless in His presence . . .
verses.literalPt: contudo, agora, vos reconciliou no corpo da sua carne pela sua morte, para vos apresentar santos, e sem defeito, e inculpáveis perante ele,

verses.original: εἴ γε ἐπιμένετε τῇ πίστει τεθεμελιωμένοι καὶ ἑδραῖοι καὶ μὴ μετακινούμενοι ἀπὸ τῆς ἐλπίδος τοῦ εὐαγγελίου οὗ ἠκούσατε τοῦ κηρυχθέντος ἐν πάσῃ κτίσει τῇ ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανόν οὗ ἐγενόμην ἐγὼ Παῦλος διάκονος
verses.transliteration: ei ge epimenete tē pistei tethemeliōmenoi kai hedraioi kai mē metakinoumenoi apo tēs elpidos tou euangeliou hou ēkousate tou kērychthentos en pasē ktisei tē hypo ton ouranon hou egenomēn egō Paulos diakonos
verses.literal: if indeed you continue in your faith established and firm not moved from the hope of the gospel you heard which has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven and of which I Paul have become a servant
verses.literalPt: se é que permaneceis na fé, fundados e firmes e não vos deixando apartar da esperança do evangelho que ouvistes e que foi pregado a toda criatura debaixo do céu, e do qual eu, Paulo, fui feito ministro.

verses.original: Νῦν χαίρω ἐν τοῖς παθήμασιν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ ἀνταναπληρῶ τὰ ὑστερήματα τῶν θλίψεων τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐν τῇ σαρκί μου ὑπὲρ τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ ὅ ἐστιν ἡ ἐκκλησία
verses.transliteration: Nyn chairō en tois pathēmasin hyper hymōn kai antanaplērō ta hysterēmata tōn thlipseōn tou Christou en tē sarki mou hyper tou sōmatos autou ho estin hē ekklēsia
verses.literal: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you . . . and I fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body which is the church
verses.literalPt: Agora, me regozijo nos meus sofrimentos por vós; e da minha parte cumpro o que falta das aflições de Cristo, na minha carne, por seu corpo, que é a Igreja;

verses.original: ἧς ἐγενόμην ἐγὼ διάκονος κατὰ τὴν οἰκονομίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ τὴν δοθεῖσάν μοι εἰς ὑμᾶς πληρῶσαι τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hēs egenomēn egō diakonos kata tēn oikonomian tou Theou tēn dotheisan moi eis hymas plērōsai ton logon tou Theou
verses.literal: I became its servant by the commission God gave me to fully proclaim to you the word of God
verses.literalPt: da qual eu fui constituído ministro segundo a dispensação de Deus, que me foi dada para convosco, a fim de cumprir a palavra de Deus:

verses.original: τὸ μυστήριον τὸ ἀποκεκρυμμένον ἀπὸ τῶν αἰώνων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν γενεῶν νῦν δὲ ἐφανερώθη τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: to mystērion to apokekrymmenon apo tōn aiōnōn kai apo tōn geneōn nyn de ephanerōthē tois hagiois autou
verses.literal: the mystery that was hidden for ages and - generations but is now revealed to His saints
verses.literalPt: o mistério que esteve escondido dos séculos e das gerações; mas, agora, foi descoberto a seus santos;

verses.original: οἷς ἠθέλησεν ὁ Θεὸς γνωρίσαι τί τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης τοῦ μυστηρίου τούτου ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ὅ ἐστιν Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς δόξης
verses.transliteration: hois ēthelēsen ho Theos gnōrisai ti to ploutos tēs doxēs tou mystēriou toutou en tois ethnesin ho estin Christos en hymin hē elpis tēs doxēs
verses.literal: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery which is Christ in you the hope of glory
verses.literalPt: a quem aprouve a Deus fazer conhecer quais são as riquezas da glória desse mistério entre os gentios, que é, em vós, Cristo, esperança da glória;

verses.original: ὃν ἡμεῖς καταγγέλλομεν νουθετοῦντες πάντα ἄνθρωπον καὶ διδάσκοντες πάντα ἄνθρωπον ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ ἵνα παραστήσωμεν πάντα ἄνθρωπον τέλειον ἐν Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: hon hēmeis katangellomen nouthetountes panta anthrōpon kai didaskontes panta anthrōpon en pasē sophia hina parastēsōmen panta anthrōpon teleion en Christō
verses.literal: We proclaim Him admonishing - and teaching everyone with all wisdom so that we may present everyone perfect in Christ
verses.literalPt: a quem nós anunciamos, admoestando e ensinando a todo homem em toda a sabedoria, para que apresentemos todo homem perfeito em Cristo;

verses.original: Εἰς ὃ καὶ κοπιῶ ἀγωνιζόμενος κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐνεργουμένην ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐν δυνάμει
verses.transliteration: Eis ho kai kopiō agōnizomenos kata tēn energeian autou tēn energoumenēn en emoi en dynamei
verses.literal: To this end I also labor striving with all His energy working powerfully within me
verses.literalPt: para o que também eu trabalho, esforçando-me segundo a sua operação que obra poderosamente em mim.
